3106 - Senior Data Governance Analyst - UK

Role Summary and Impact

The MFG team is seeking an experienced and proactive Senior Data Governance Analyst to join our global Data Governance team. This pivotal role will be responsible for driving quality assurance oversight on critical business processes where data is collected, stored, transformed, or used. You will take ownership of identifying, analyzing, and resolving complex data quality issues, leading coordination efforts with internal and external teams. As a Senior Analyst, you will also independently manage and contribute significantly to strategic Data Governance initiatives, helping to define and implement best practices across the organization.

Some of the things we'd like you to do:

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of weekly dashboards that evaluate datasets for quality and accuracy, providing actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders.
